videos.desc: An election night campaign room. A woman in a cream blazer with a big ribbon rosette on her chest stands clasping her hands in front of a screen showing a rising bar chart of results, surrounded by supporters in blue campaign T-shirts with her name on them. Their faces are tense, hands over mouths; a close-up shows her staring at the screen. Then the result lands: she throws her head back and screams with joy, the room erupts with raised fists, balloons and confetti, and her team lifts her up on their shoulders.

In a grand hotel lobby with wooden wall panels, a brass starburst chandelier, a floating staircase, a teal sofa and a brass luggage trolley, a young man in a navy jacket and cream trousers walks towards the revolving glass door holding a quilted beige handbag with a chain strap. A young woman with a braided bun, in a burgundy blazer and black skirt, catches him by the back of his jacket. He stops, turns round and holds up the handbag while she holds out her open hand. A receptionist in green stands behind the desk.

In an army camp with olive canvas tents on red earth, a young woman in a navy work uniform salutes with a glum, pouting face while a young man in the same uniform hands her a potato peeler and one potato falls into a sack. She takes the peeler with a sigh, then crouches down beside several huge open sacks full of potatoes and picks one up, while he stands and watches. Behind them are a large steel cooking pot on a stand, a metal bucket and a stone water trough, with pine trees and more tents behind.

In a wood-panelled debating hall with chandeliers and old portraits on the walls, a young woman in a navy blazer leans over a wooden lectern, pointing her finger and shouting at a young man in a white shirt at the lectern opposite. He leans on his lectern with a startled face as sheets of paper fall from it. She then turns away with her arms crossed and walks off, and he stares after her. In the background a young woman in a burgundy jumper sits at a small table taking notes next to glasses of water.

A field of dry golden grass after a battle lies under dark storm clouds. Round wooden shields with metal centres are scattered everywhere, arrows stick up out of the ground and a torn red banner flutters on a leaning pole. A saddled chestnut horse with no rider grazes in the middle, lifts its head to look around and then lowers it to graze again. On the right a wooden cart burns with orange flames and grey smoke. Beyond a low stone wall a stone castle with square towers stands on a rocky hill.

In an old courtroom with dark wood panelling and tall windows letting in hazy sunlight, a young lawyer in a dark three-piece suit and tie walks across the floor holding a sheaf of papers and points at a muddy old bicycle on a wooden stand with a yellow evidence tag numbered 2. He stops, turns, then flings his arm out towards the bicycle and speaks with his mouth wide open as a sheet falls from his hand. Clumps of dried mud lie on the floor, and people in suits sit watching on the benches.

In an old underground office inside an arched stone tunnel lit by green desk lamps, a young woman with her hair pinned up in an old-fashioned style, in a green blouse and navy skirt, sits at a riveted metal desk. She lays a metal ruler across a handwritten letter on a glass sheet and runs a small blade along it to cut out a line, then sits back and smiles. Stacks of envelopes sit on the desk, a wire basket below is full of cut paper strips, and another woman works at a desk behind her.

On a big steel bridge on a misty morning, a young woman in an orange jacket and green headscarf sits cross-legged on the wet road and shouts into a megaphone, one arm locked into a painted tube joining her to the next person. Other young protesters in warm hats sit in a line across the lanes under a flag with a burning globe. She leans forward and keeps shouting, then lowers the megaphone and stares straight ahead in silence. A police officer in a yellow vest stands behind her, and lorries wait with their lights on.

On the rainy deck of a navy ship in a harbour, an older woman in a long dark navy coat with gold buttons, thick gold stripes on the sleeves and a white-topped peaked cap stands on a wooden step, raises her hand and salutes. She holds the salute, then drops her arm and speaks. Behind her a line of young sailors in dark uniforms and white caps stands to attention, one of them saluting, and an officer in a raincoat watches. A flag flies from a mast above them and a small tugboat waits on the grey water.

In the snowy courtyard of a grand stone palace, a young woman in a long grey coat and a black bowler-style hat, a sealed white envelope under her arm, leans in and pushes hard on the big golden wheel of a gilded carriage stuck in the snow, helped by footmen in red coats. Then she straightens up, turns and smiles, holding the envelope, while a footman opens a black umbrella. White horses stand in harness and men in dark suits wait on the palace steps as snow falls.

In a luxury flat with tall windows over the sea, left in a mess after a wild party, a serious woman in glasses, red lipstick and a dark grey trouser suit walks forward and holds out a thick contract with coloured tabs and a pen on top, speaking firmly. Behind her a man in a shirt sleeping on the sofa wakes up and sits up. Banknotes, playing cards, confetti and bottles lie on the floor and rug, and a curtain blows in the wind.

On a busy sandy beach under dark storm clouds, with rough grey waves and a wooden lifeguard tower, a young woman in a dark navy uniform jacket and white shirt walks towards the camera, raises a megaphone and shouts through it. Beside her a young lifeguard in red shorts carries a red flag on a pole, and police officers in light blue shirts and caps walk with her. Sunbathers fill the beach behind them, and a beach umbrella blows away in the wind.

At the tall wrought-iron gates of a grand stone castle with towers on a sunny day, a smiling young man in a green tweed jacket, checked shirt and tie swings one gate wide open and steps aside to let villagers in for a summer fair. People carry a wooden folding table, a woman in a pink dress hurries in with a cake tin and a scruffy dog runs past. An old man in a tweed waistcoat holding a ring of keys watches, and bunting and a small flag lie on the gravel.

In a grand hall with a crystal chandelier, tall windows and gold-framed portraits, a young man in a black tailcoat, white bow tie, a wide blue sash and a gold star medal stands at the top of red-carpeted marble stairs and calmly leans forward to reach for a silver tray held out by a young maid in a black dress and white apron, who holds up a glass. Guests in evening gowns, long gloves and suits watch from below in shock.

A large white government building with a tall dome, rows of columns and a gold statue on top stands across a snowy plaza on a bright winter day. A long line of men and women in dark coats with briefcases walks carefully down wide snowy stone steps beside a colonnade, past a metal handrail. A fountain sprays by the columns, a yellow snowplough clears the road, a flock of birds swirls above the dome, and a lost glove lies in the snow on the steps.

At an old-style army camp in a flooded field in pouring rain, a senior officer in a peaked cap with a red band, gold badges on his shoulders and a long dark greatcoat stands on the bonnet of a muddy vintage car, pointing with both arms and shouting orders. Soldiers in round helmets pull on the ropes of a sagging tent, papers blow away, a saddled horse runs loose and a brass band plays behind. A dog splashes through the water with a second officer's cap in its mouth.

In a school gym with a wooden floor and basketball hoops, rows of people sit on folding chairs at a town hall meeting. A young politician in a white shirt, a dark tie and navy trousers crouches and holds a microphone out to an older man in a plaid shirt and a green cap, who points his finger and speaks firmly. The politician listens closely as the view moves nearer. A paper coffee cup, a newspaper and a crumpled paper lie on the floor.

An old wood-panelled courtroom with tall arched windows. A young man with slicked-back dark hair and a beard, in a navy suit, stands in the dock gripping its brass rail, looks down and slowly bows his head, a guard in a white shirt standing beside him. Below, a lawyer in a white wig and black gown sits at a desk piled with files, and a man in a tweed jacket holds up a sheet of paper. A judge in a red robe sits at the back and the public gallery above is full of watching people.

A formal wood-panelled meeting room with tall windows and heavy grey curtains. Around a long polished table covered with stacks of papers and paper cups, one knocked over, sit people in dark suits. A woman in a grey suit leans forward calmly and pushes a handwritten document across the table to a man opposite, who picks it up, while a man beside her argues with his hand raised and then sits back. Others look on seriously. A wall clock, a coffee jug and a brass wall lamp are behind them.

On the lawn of a grand country estate on a grey day, a smiling grey-bearded older man in a red velvet robe with a white ermine cape and a jewelled gold crown rides a muddy quad bike towards the camera, first holding his crown with one hand and then gripping the handlebars. He laughs as the quad splashes through a big muddy puddle, and mud and water spray from the wheels. Behind him stand large old trees and a pale stone mansion with tall columns.

In front of a stone country mansion under a cloudy sky, a young blond man in a dark suit and a long red velvet robe trimmed with white fur hurries across the gravel and bends to catch a round leather hat box rolling away from him. Two shaggy grey wolfhounds run up to him and sniff at the box as he lifts it, smiling. Then he turns and walks off towards the house with the dogs beside him. A butler in black stands on the front steps, a flag flies on the roof and an old black car is parked on the right.

On a wide city street full of marchers, a young woman with braids, a denim jacket and a purple bandana sits on a friend's shoulders and punches the air with a purple scarf tied to her fist. She shouts at first, then keeps her fist raised with a calm, proud face while the friend below her starts to smile. Her white T-shirt shows a big purple female symbol. Around her a crowd of women in purple T-shirts raise their fists and hold cardboard signs with the same symbol, and purple smoke drifts.

Seen from above, an old stone fort stands on a rocky point in a stormy sea. A huge white wave crashes over the thick walls and floods across the wet parade ground, where rows of soldiers in dark uniforms stand in formation, then water pours back off the walls. A sunbeam breaks through grey clouds behind, smoke rises from the chimneys of a long stone barracks next to a small round watchtower, a few soldiers move along the wall, and a small boat rocks in the white water below.

At night on a wet airport runway in the rain, a thin young woman in a grey tracksuit, wrapped in a grey blanket, walks away from a small private jet, held around the shoulders by a man. They stop, and she throws her arms around him and cries on his shoulder while he holds her head. By the plane's steps a man in a dark coat stands still and a woman in a dark uniform wipes her eyes. Behind a barrier a small crowd waits under tall floodlights, and a bunch of flowers lies on the wet tarmac.

A snowy frozen river under an iron city bridge. A young man with dark hair, in a long grey wool coat, a suit and leather gloves, stands on the ice and points ahead, giving orders. A young police officer in a dark uniform and cap walks up to him with a plastic evidence bag and hands it over, and the man takes it. Other officers and a police dog stand nearby. Behind yellow tape a red car stands nose-down in the ice, workers in white suits examine it, and people look down from the bridge.

An inspection room with grey lockers and a barred window. A young woman in a white lab coat and gloves lifts a carved pale ivory bangle out of a wooden crate labelled as wooden ornaments, with straw packing spilling out. She holds it up, looks at it closely under a lamp and then lays it on the steel table, where a whole elephant tusk, rows of ivory bangles, chess pieces, small carved figures and a magnifying visor lie. Two colleagues in lab coats write notes and open another crate behind her.

At an aid delivery in a valley under grey clouds, a large twin-rotor military helicopter stands on muddy grass with its rear ramp open and its rotors turning. In front, a young officer in camouflage uniform and cap directs the work with sweeping arm movements and finally a raised hand, while soldiers carry sacks of rice and cases of bottled water off the helicopter to a pickup truck. A split rice sack lies in the grass, villagers wait by the truck and houses stand on the hillside.

A wood-panelled courtroom in grey daylight. A middle-aged man in a navy suit and white shirt stands in the wooden dock behind a brass rail with a cold, blank face, his wrists in handcuffs, while a uniformed officer holds his arm. The view moves slowly closer to him. Behind him a woman in black bends over and cries into a dark coat. A woman lawyer in front lays her hand on a thick file next to a water jug, and rows of serious people watch under tall windows.

A wet street outside an old red-brick prison with towers and a huge arched wooden gate. A young man in a black bomber jacket, grey hoodie and black trousers walks out of the small open door carrying a plastic bag of belongings, shading his eyes against the daylight, then smiles. A uniformed guard stands in the doorway behind him. A friend in a dark jacket runs up the street from a parked car, and the two men hug tightly on the pavement.

A wood-panelled courtroom with tall arched windows. An older judge in a black robe reads a paper at the high bench under a green lamp. At the tables in front, a young woman in a navy suit covers her mouth in shock while the woman beside her puts a hand on her back, then she stands up and turns to lean over the table towards that woman. On the other side a man in a grey suit holds his head in both hands. A clerk types on a laptop, files lie on the tables, and people watch from the benches.

A meeting in an old hall with tall arched windows, a wooden parquet floor and colourful bunting. Young people sit on rows of wooden chairs and many raise their hands high in the air. A young woman in a dark red jumper and white skirt walks in front holding a clipboard, pointing at the raised hands as she counts them, then stops and writes on the clipboard. A young man in a white shirt stands behind with his arms folded, watching. Daylight comes in through the windows.

A sunny city street lined with cafes and trees. A bright yellow sports car is parked up on the pavement, its front wheels blocking the walkway beside a pedestrian crossing. A police officer in a navy uniform and cap stands at the windscreen and puts a parking ticket under the wiper. People at the cafe tables turn to watch, a young woman in an orange top walks past, and a young man in a white linen shirt and trousers rushes out of the cafe with his arms raised in protest.

A sunny old-town square with stone buildings, iron balconies, café chairs and a stone fountain. Two tall clear tubes stand on the paving: one is filling with green tennis balls, the other with orange balls. A young woman in a blue denim jacket stands between them, and a young woman in a lilac top holds a green ball, bends down and drops it into the green tube. A young man with a skateboard stands nearby, a cyclist rides past behind, people watch and chat, and a pigeon flies up from the ground.
